blocks.task_summary: Given A(0,p,2), B(1,1,1), C(p,0,4) with p>0, find vectors AB and AC, compute AB×AC via determinant, and simplify to the column vector (2−3p, −2−p, p²−2p).
accepted_alternatives: Cross product may be expressed using i, j, k unit vectors instead of determinant notation.

evidence.basis: A1 for AB; A1 for AC; M1 for attempt to evaluate cross product by formula or determinant; A1 for correct simplified cross product marked AG. OR notation for i,j,k expansion also shown.

blocks.task_summary: Expand |AB×AC|² to the quartic p⁴−4p³+14p²−8p+8, then find its minimum value 6.75.
method_path: Compute |AB×AC|² as sum of squares of the three components
Differentiate or use GDC to find critical point p≈0.3264
accepted_alternatives: Minimum may be found by GDC instead of calculus differentiation.

evidence.basis: (A1) for correct expansion of |AB×AC|²; (M1) for attempt to find minimum; A1 for min value 6.75. Markscheme gives p≈0.3264... or 6.75257... as intermediate values.

blocks.task_summary: Use area = ½|AB×AC| with the minimum magnitude from part (b) to find the smallest possible area of triangle ABC, giving 1.30 units².

evidence.basis: (M1) for valid attempt to find area = ½|AB×AC| using answer from part (b); A1 for 1.30 units².
